scope: Current-machine integrated CPU asset identity/dependency/cache/job qualification; all four REQ-11 checkpoints qualify. Source decoders and UI/CLI adapters retain their later owners.
qualification_method: Five complete inventories are partitioned into disjoint functional and serialized I/O-heavy passing CTest runs, plus two complete standalone Tools selections. Every aggregate case preserves its original source JUnit and hash. No failed or partial run is relabeled, and no retry is used in these final selections.

acceptance_evidence.requirement: Renaming or moving source assets preserves references; changed content/settings/tool versions invalidate the correct dependents.
Matching work deduplicates, and cancelled/failed imports never publish corrupt cache output.
The same declared inputs and tool versions reproduce import output.
Missing assets follow the explicit documented policy, and job concurrency remains bounded.
Preserve dependency metadata needed for bounded asynchronous cell streaming and separate client/server cook roots; imports must not run on a live simulation/render thread.

Shared import services expose bounded job status, diagnostics, cancellation and artifact identity to later UI/CLI adapters. Changed source/settings or cancellation before publication cannot replace newer valid output.

unchanged_protected_inputs.note: Protected source bytes match the qualified 11b freeze. Current protected builds/packages are refreshed; no new full Server execution is claimed.

not_run: New full Server suites: protected source equality retains both qualified 11b Server suites; current protected builds/packages pass
New GPU qualification: only CPU authoring fixtures changed; earlier graphics evidence remains historical
